disease_state: Matched urine samples were collected from prostate cancer patients prior to (n = 12) and 3 months after local treatment by radical prostatectomy or intensity-modulated radiation therapy (n = 10).
material_type: Urine from men with prostate cancer prior to (n = 12) and after local treatment (n = 10), and urine from healthy controls with BPH (n = 12), was fractionated in EV- and protein-enriched fractions, which were analysed by LC-MS/MS.
sample_source: Matched urine samples were collected from prostate cancer patients prior to (n = 12) and 3 months after local treatment by radical prostatectomy or intensity-modulated radiation therapy (n = 10).
sex: Mass spectrometry-based proteomic analysis of urinary EV (uEV) in men with benign and malignant prostate disease allowed us to significantly expand the known human uEV proteome with high specificity and identifies a unique biological profile in prostate cancer not uncovered by the analysis of soluble proteins.
species: Tandem mass spectra were searched using the MaxQuant software (version 1.5.2.8) against a database containing both reviewed (SwissProt) and unreviewed (TrEMBL) sequences of homo sapiens, including different isoforms, of UniProtKB release 2018_07.
